title: Yoga & Journaling: Move, Breathe, Release
description: Move & breathe with P4L + Cuties Los Angeles!
long_description:
Move & breathe with P4L + Cuties Los Angeles!

About this Event

Unwind through gentle movement and honest reflection in this P4L and collaboration that pairs a grounding yin yoga practice with guided journaling. We'll flow through the body first, then settle into stillness with the page - creating space to process, release, and reconnect with self. All levels and bodies welcome; no writing or yoga experience required. Mats will be provided.

Tickets
Parenting for Liberation believes that Black parents and families deserve access to creative and healing spaces without the barrier of cost. We believe in reducing and eliminating barriers to our program offerings when possible, and we also believe in equity and resource sharing. Tickets to our 10 year programming allows us to continue serving our community in the long-term. Please see the descriptions below to determine which ticket level is best for you.
Complimentary tickets - Supports our community members that want to attend but simply don’t have the means at the moment. We encourage folks to sign up early since there are a limited amount available for the event.
Community Pricing - Supports our community members that are unable to afford the General admission price, but are still able to contribute to the cost.
General Admission - Supports our community members that can cover the cost for the type of event.
Pay it Forward - Supports our community members that are able to cover their own costs, and a little extra for another community member.

Also check out other in Los Angeles, Health & Wellness events in Los Angeles.
